title: split init hook flow into phased hooks and add namespace-scoped value overrides for private installs
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: Private deployments require more deterministic init sequencing and per-namespace configuration for multiline tenant topologies. This PR splits the monolithic init hook into three explicit phases (preflight, tenant-init, post-init), and introduces a namespace-scoped overrides mechanism (values.namespaceOverrides) to allow different tenant namespaces to opt into different resource/timeout profiles without templating hacks. Summary of changes: 1) Templates: extract init jobs into charts/private/templates/hooks/preflight-job.yaml, tenant-init-job.yaml, postinit-job.yaml with idempotent guards and improved RBAC scoping; 2) Values schema: expand values.schema.json to validate namespaceOverrides: map[string]{resources,hookPolicy,timeoutSeconds,runAsNonRoot} and soft-validate hook phases; 3) Hook controller: add annotations and deterministic ordering (hook.phase: preflight|tenant|post) plus retry/backoff annotations used by our helm hook runner; 4) Backcompat: default behavior preserved when values.namespaceOverrides absent (old single-init behaviour retained via compatibility shim); 5) Docs: examples in values.example.yaml and upgrade notes in CHART-CHANGELOG.md. Testing and rollout: unit+integration helm tests added to chart-tests (preflight dry-run, simulated multi-namespace install), manual on-prem install test against a 3-tenant VPC cluster (timeouts tuned), and canary rollout documented for Dedicated conversion. Related: links to Linear ENG-6123 and ENG-6187. Checklist: - [x] Values schema and examples - [x] Hook templates extracted and covered by unit tests - [x] E2E canary on internal k8s cluster - [x] Release notes prepared

  annotations:
    helm.sh/hook: post-install,pre-upgrade
    helm.sh/hook-weight: "10"
    redwood.dev/hook-phase: "tenant"

review_conversation: Diego Alvarez (review): Can we guarantee ordering in clusters with slow API server responses? Suggest adding explicit helm.sh/hook-weight to enforce sequence.
Maya Chen (author): Added helm.sh/hook-weight and a redwood.dev/hook-phase annotation; also added idempotency marker files in the job to prevent double-run on retries.
Priya Singh (review): The namespaceOverrides schema is powerful but could be misused. Suggest limiting additionalProperties to a small allowlist (resources, timeoutSeconds, hookPolicy).
Maya Chen (author): Narrowed schema to the allowlist and added docs/examples that show safe patterns; also added runtime validation log when unknown keys present.
Evan Park (approval): Verified RBAC scoping change and ran e2e canary; approving pending changelog entry.
Release Manager (comment): Please include upgrade notes for customers who relied on the old single init job behavior. Added CHART-CHANGELOG.md entry.
release_notes:
- Helm chart: split install init sequence into preflight/tenant/post-init hooks to improve determinism for multi-tenant Private installs.
- New values.namespaceOverrides allows per-namespace resource and hook policy customization.
- Backwards compatible: default behavior unchanged when no namespaceOverrides provided.
- Added chart-tests and e2e dry-run coverage for phased hooks.
